details:
- CVE-2026-21945: security component vulnerability allowing unauthenticated
  attackers with network access to cause denial of service
- CVE-2026-21933: networking component vulnerability allowing unauthenticated
  attackers with network access to compromise confidentiality and integrity
- CVE-2026-21925: RMI component vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers
  with network access to compromise confidentiality and integrity
- CVE-2025-65018: heap buffer overflow in libpng png_combine_row triggered via
  png_image_finish_read when processing 16-bit interlaced PNGs with 8-bit output
- CVE-2025-64720: out-of-bounds read in libpng png_image_read_composite when
  processing palette PNG images with PNG_FLAG_OPTIMIZE_ALPHA enabled
